g.title: flashhub_flow
g.text: this repo builds, packs and validates; upload is manual, consumers resolve and sync over HTTP

g.title: pack
g.text: writes build provenance; never packages weights

g.title: validate
g.text: validates the source tree, not dist

g.title: upload
g.text: no upload client in this repo
preserve relative paths; the version is the ref

g.title: app_api
g.text: app manifest + setup scripts + default bundles

g.title: srv_preload
g.text: disk only; the scheduler starts residents on demand

g.title: srv_catalog
g.text: live request every time; no 5-minute cache

g.title: srv_app
g.text: setup writes Connection only; never starts models

g.title: desktop
g.text: talks to flashserver only, never the FlashHub API
installer/cover URLs may be fetched directly
